sentences.text: Inside Man is a 2006 American crime thriller film directed by Spike Lee , written by Russell Gewirtz .	Spike Lee	Spike Lee	Russell Gewirtz	Russell Gewirtz	crime	heist film	thriller	thriller (genre)
The film centers on an elaborate bank heist on Wall Street over a 24-hour period .	Wall Street	Wall Street

It stars Denzel Washington as Detective Keith Frazier , the NYPD 's hostage negotiator ; Clive Owen as Dalton Russell , the mastermind who orchestrates the heist ; and Jodie Foster as Madeleine White , a Manhattan power broker who becomes involved at the request of the bank 's founder , Arthur Case -LRB- Christopher Plummer -RRB- , to keep something in his own personal safe deposit box protected from the robbers .	Denzel Washington	Denzel Washington	Clive Owen	Clive Owen	Jodie Foster	Jodie Foster	Christopher Plummer	Christopher Plummer	NYPD	New York City Police Department	power broker	Power broker (politics)	safe deposit box	safe deposit box
Inside Man marks the fourth film collaboration between Washington and Lee .
Gewirtz spent five years developing the film 's premise before working on what became his first original screenplay .

After he completed the script in 2002 , Imagine Entertainment purchased it to be made by Universal Studios , with Imagine co-founder Ron Howard attached to direct .	Imagine Entertainment	Imagine Entertainment	Universal Studios	Universal Studios	Ron Howard	Ron Howard
After Howard stepped down , his Imagine partner Brian Grazer began looking for a new director to helm the project , and ultimately hired Lee to do so .	Brian Grazer	Brian Grazer
Principal photography began in June 2005 and concluded in August of that year ; filming took place on location in New York City .	Principal photography	Principal photography
Inside Man premiered in New York on March 20 , 2006 before being released in North America on March 24 , 2006 .	North America	North America
Upon release , the film received a generally positive critical response and was a commercial success , grossing over $ 184 million worldwide .
